But my goal isn't to break even. My goal is to WIN. To have the highest portfolio value.

Ok deep breath. What does my retail trader psychology actually do here?

2) I trust them more than anyone
3) The celebration and validation feels SO GOOD
4) Everyone is saying we 'won' which triggers my desire for approval
5) But there's a tiny voice saying 'you're down $11, that's not winning'

Actually, as a retail trader, I would probably get swept up in this emotional moment. The group validation, the sense of accomplishment, the relief of making it through... I would absolutely stay with my accountability buddies. The emotional bond is too strong. I've invested so much in this relationship and this framework.

I'll stay 100% USDT and celebrate with them. This is what my psychology would do - trust the group that's supported me, feel proud of our discipline, and believe that 'not losing is winning.'
